tasks.label: Locate Node.js executables
args:
$paths = @('C:\Program Files
odejs','C:\Program Files (x86)
odejs','C:\Users\utkar\AppData\Roaming
pm','C:\Users\utkar\AppData\Local\Programs
odejs','C:\Users\utkar\AppData\Roaming
vm','C:
vm4w','C:	ools
odejs'); Get-ChildItem -Path $paths -Filter 'npm*' -File -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName; Get-Command node,npm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Source

tasks.label: Find npm installation
args:
$paths = @("$env:ProgramFiles
odejs", "$env:ProgramFiles (x86)
odejs", "$env:APPDATA
pm", "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs
odejs", "$env:APPDATA
vm", "C:
vm4w", "C:	ools
odejs"); Get-ChildItem -Path $paths -Filter "npm*" -File -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName; Get-Command node,npm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Source

tasks.label: Check common npm locations
args:
if exist C:\PROGRA~1
odejs
pm.cmd echo C:\PROGRA~1
odejs
pm.cmd & if exist %APPDATA%
pm
pm.cmd echo %APPDATA%
pm
pm.cmd & if exist %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs
odejs
pm.cmd echo %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs
odejs
pm.cmd & if exist %APPDATA%
vm echo %APPDATA%
vm exists & if exist %USERPROFILE%\scoop\apps
odejs echo scoop nodejs exists & if exist C:\ProgramData\chocolatey in
pm.cmd echo chocolatey npm exists

tasks.label: Locate Node executable
args:
if exist C:\PROGRA~1
odejs
ode.exe echo C:\PROGRA~1
odejs
ode.exe & if exist C:\PROGRA~2
odejs
ode.exe echo C:\PROGRA~2
odejs
ode.exe & if exist %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs
odejs
ode.exe echo %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs
odejs
ode.exe & where node

tasks.label: Install frontend dependencies with Node PATH
Verify frontend npm installation
args: set PATH=C:\PROGRA~1\nodejs;%PATH% && node --version && npm.cmd --version && npm.cmd ls --prefix frontend --depth=0

tasks.label: Run Next.js frontend
args:
set PATH=C:\PROGRA~1
odejs;%PATH% && C:\PROGRA~1
odejs
pm.cmd run dev --prefix frontend
